summary: Two hikers forced to bivouac near the summit of 14,075-ft Mt. Columbia after windblown snow crystals blinded one of them; overnight ski/snowshoe rescue, both escorted off with minor injuries
notes: Seven-hour overnight rescue; clear of field 4:28am
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount Columbia)
